appearance_facts.fact: Three blue vertical bars are labeled on the x-axis as January, February, and March.
A black dashed horizontal line labeled Average runs across the plot at a height between the 400 and 500 y-axis ticks.
The top of the January bar aligns with the dashed Average line, appearing at the same height.
The February bar top is below the Average line (near 380), and the March bar top is further below (near 250).

public_definitions: Assign January to the handling route that fits its discharge position relative to the monthly average level.
Options: Route January to elevated discharge monitoring; Route January to average-band discharge monitoring; Route January to reduced discharge conservation review.
uncertain: The exact numeric value of the Average line is not printed; it is read visually as between 400 and 500.
The exact numeric value of the January bar is not printed; it is read visually as aligning with the Average line.
